newsitem.title: USA: Chase Manhattan acquires Mellon Bank unit.
newsitem.headline: Chase Manhattan acquires Mellon Bank unit.

text.p: The Chase Manhattan Bank said Wednesday that it has signed a definitive agreement to purchase the corporate trustee and agency business of Mellon Bank for its Global Trust unit, which provides transaction processing and trust services for corporate and institutional customers.
The Mellon unit consists primarily of 6,600 corporate and municipal bond customers. The sale, said Chase, does not affect Mellon's substantial non-corporate trustee fiduciary business.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but the bank said it expected to complete the sale in the fourth quarter.
Chase has said that its strategy is to grow its corporate trust business nationwide.
Chase said that the deal would add about $70 billion of securities under mangement to Global Trust, which has about $1.4 trillion in assets currently under administration.
